Subject: Black Friday pilot — temporary capacity uplift request

Hi Kimberly,

Following our product sync, we need a provisional quota uplift for a 5-day Black Friday pilot (Nov 24-28). Expected peak QPS pattern is attached (BF_pilot_capacity_plan.xlsx). Primary asks: a) raise concurrency/window for the pilot window to avoid throttling, and b) provide a temporary overrun pricing option — ideally a blended rate that is lower than standard pay-as-you-go overrun given this is a trial tied to a longer-term commit discussion.

We're aiming to convert to a committed tier if pilot metrics hit the targets — Maria has already flagged this to procurement. Can Redwood propose a short-term SLA for the window and an overrun rate we can ship as part of our pilot contract?

Attachments: BF_pilot_capacity_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Integrations — FastRetail
procurement@fastretail.com

Hi Maria — thanks for the plan and heads-up. Short answers up-front: we can provision a temporary concurrency bump and apply a time-boxed blended overrun rate for the five-day pilot. A few clarifying points before Ben and Dev propose numbers/ops:

- Can you confirm the target peak QPS and % of traffic that will be cart-check/categorization vs. background embeddings?
- Will all pilot requests route through a single API key or multiple client keys? (affects rate-limit config)
- Do you need streaming responses for cart-check flows or simple completion endpoints?

Ben will propose pricing terms (blended overrun + any pilot discount) and Dev will confirm the schedule for capacity changes and any required config flags. Once we agree, we'll send a short amendment and DocuSign link. I copied procurement in their procurement alias so legal/PO can follow.

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Black Friday pilot — temporary capacity uplift request

Hi all — quick commercial proposal to move this forward:

1) Temporary uplift: +200% concurrency for 5 days (Nov 24-28) with a pre-authorized soft cap so we can monitor.
2) Blended overrun rate: For any usage above the customer's committed baseline during the pilot window, propose a blended overrun of $0.012/token equivalent (capped at 2x standard pay-as-you-go) — this reflects a pilot discount and reduces sticker shock for procurement.
3) Commitment trigger: If pilot hits >70% of KPI targets (latency, error rate, quality), FastRetail commits to a 6-month reserved tier (details in the attached MoP) and we convert usage to committed pricing pro-rated from the conversion date.
4) Legal/PO: we will issue a 1-page amendment that time-boxes the uplift and includes a rollback clause. DocuSign link will follow.

Notes: The blended rate above is conditional on pilot-only traffic being routed to the uplifted key and our telemetry hooks being enabled (to prevent signal bleed). Open to a smaller uplift or higher blended rate if procurement needs a simpler sign-off.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_mop_v2.pdf (one-pager)

> On Nov 3, 2026, Kimberly Park wrote: > Short answers up-front: we can provision a temporary concurrency bump and apply a time-boxed blended overrun rate...

Subject: Re: Black Friday pilot — temporary capacity uplift request

Hi team — technical confirmation and ops plan below.

- Feasibility: We can apply a per-key concurrency window increase and an elevated QPS soft cap in the us-west region for Nov 24 00:00 — Nov 28 23:59 PT. We will place a monitoring guardrail that throttles only after soft cap + buffer and triggers alerts to both SRE and the AE.
- Telemetry: We'll enable the prefix/KV caching and a temporary batching increase for the uplifted route to hold latency close to normal. We require the client to use the single uplifted API key (Kimberly, please confirm).
- Cutover timing: Changes will be staged 48 hours prior for a dry-run and then elevated at 00:00 PT on Nov 24. Rollback window: automatic rollback at 24:00 PT on Nov 28 unless an extension is approved.
- Rate-limit upgrade: No infra changes required; config-only. We can complete the change after DocuSign is executed and we have billing pre-authorization.

Maria — if that plan works for FastRetail, Ben and Kimberly will send the amendment and DocuSign. I also attached a short ops checklist in the pilot MoP.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Engineer, Platform — Redwood Inference
